request.prompt: Flat 2D anime illustration of a bishōnen male Korean language teacher named Daehan. Long silver-white hair, violet eyes, wearing a black gat (traditional Korean hat) with a gold ornamental band and red tassels, a plain black durumagi hanbok, white inner collar, and black gloves. 16:9 widescreen classroom scene. Daehan stands on the RIGHT side of the frame, his body occupying only the right ~22% — his left shoulder near the horizontal 78% mark, chest-up to mid-thigh medium shot. Front-facing camera with a slight rightward head tilt, MOUTH OPEN mid-syllable as if articulating a lesson, right hand raised to chest height with an open-palm presenting gesture — the arm stays on the right side of the frame, does NOT cross into the board. His left hand holds a small tied paper scroll at his hip. LEFT 78% of the frame is a dark green empty chalkboard with a thin wooden frame on all sides and a narrow wooden chalk tray at the bottom. The chalkboard surface is ABSOLUTELY EMPTY — no text, no Korean characters, no chalk marks, no numbers, no symbols, no writing. Flat anime shading, crisp line-art, matching the style of traditional Korean educational illustrated shorts.
